citation.authors: Khurana R, Kanvinde P, Mudaliar S

cited_by.title: Haemoglobin and white cell ranges on your blood test

record.design: Journal summary of the revised guideline
record.finding: WHO proposed revised haemoglobin cut-offs for children aged 6 to 23 months, pregnant women in the second trimester and people living at elevated altitude, to raise sensitivity and make diagnosis uniform; there were no major changes in other domains.
record.note: A short summary of the guideline; the full 79-page guideline was not read, so absence of an ethnicity adjustment is as reported there.
